summary: Rebuilt fund screen on a new ScreenAll client method that fetches indiapassivefunds' screener templates 10/11/13 at pageSize=5000 and merges rows by scheme_id, instead of a single unfiltered templateId=0 call.
reason: templateId defaulted to 0 and the server returned almost no fields beyond fund name and scheme_id, making the command near-useless. The fix returns the full combined overview/returns/risk field set for every published ETF and index fund.
validated_outcome: Confirmed 335 ETFs + 370 index funds (705 total) returned with combined fields; added TestMergeScreenerEnvelope.
